relations.name: is_subclass_of
relations.definition: Every X is a kind of Y (class to broader class, e.g. FIR system -> LTI system).

relations.name: is_instance_of
relations.definition: X is a particular example of the class Y.

relations.name: is_special_case_of
relations.definition: X is a specific case of the more general Y under extra conditions.

relations.name: is_generalization_of
relations.definition: X is the more general form of Y.

relations.name: is_equivalent_to
relations.definition: X and Y are the same thing, different names for it, or interchangeable.

relations.name: is_defined_as
relations.definition: X is defined to be Y (a definition).

relations.name: is_component_of
relations.definition: X is a part of Y.

relations.name: is_decomposed_into
relations.definition: X can be broken into the components Y.

relations.name: consists_of
relations.definition: X is built from the elements Y.

relations.name: corresponds_to
relations.definition: X is paired with Y across domains or representations, without being identical.

relations.name: is_counterpart_of
relations.definition: X is the discrete-time (or continuous-time) analogue of Y.

relations.name: is_dual_of
relations.definition: X and Y mirror each other under a duality (time/frequency, analysis/synthesis).

relations.name: is_inverse_of
relations.definition: X undoes Y (inverse system, inverse transform, accumulation/difference).

relations.name: is_analogous_to
relations.definition: X plays a role similar to Y in another setting.

relations.name: is_compared_with
relations.definition: X is contrasted with Y.

relations.name: implies
relations.definition: If X holds then Y follows.

relations.name: requires_condition
relations.definition: X holds, exists or is valid only when condition Y is met.

relations.name: is_necessary_for
relations.definition: Y cannot hold unless X holds.

relations.name: is_sufficient_for
relations.definition: If X holds then Y holds.

relations.name: holds_for
relations.definition: Statement or property X is valid for the class or range Y.

relations.name: does_not_hold_for
relations.definition: X fails for the class or range Y.

relations.name: reduces_to
relations.definition: X becomes the simpler form Y in a special case or after simplification.

relations.name: is_bounded_by
relations.definition: X is limited above or below by Y.

relations.name: is_approximated_by
relations.definition: X is approximated by Y.

relations.name: has_property
relations.definition: X has the attribute or characteristic Y (causal, linear, stable, zero phase...).

relations.name: lacks_property
relations.definition: X does not have the property Y.

relations.name: preserves
relations.definition: Operation or system X leaves the quantity Y unchanged.

relations.name: changes
relations.definition: Operation or system X alters the quantity Y.

relations.name: characterized_by
relations.definition: X is described or determined by Y (e.g. an LTI system by its impulse response).

relations.name: exhibits
relations.definition: X shows the behaviour Y (ringing, overshoot, aliasing).

relations.name: is_represented_by
relations.definition: X can be expressed or written as Y (an expansion, form or representation).

relations.name: is_expressed_in_terms_of
relations.definition: X is written using Y.

relations.name: has_fourier_transform
relations.definition: Y is the Fourier transform of X.

relations.name: has_laplace_transform
relations.definition: Y is the Laplace transform of X.

relations.name: has_z_transform
relations.definition: Y is the z-transform of X.

relations.name: has_inverse_transform
relations.definition: Y is the inverse transform of X.

relations.name: is_transform_pair_with
relations.definition: X and Y are a transform pair.

relations.name: has_fourier_series
relations.definition: Y is the Fourier series of periodic signal X.

relations.name: has_fourier_coefficient
relations.definition: Y is a Fourier series coefficient of periodic signal X.

relations.name: is_derivative_of
relations.definition: X is the derivative of Y.

relations.name: is_integral_of
relations.definition: X is the integral of Y.

relations.name: is_first_difference_of
relations.definition: X is the first difference of Y.

relations.name: is_running_sum_of
relations.definition: X is the running sum (accumulation) of Y.

relations.name: is_running_integral_of
relations.definition: X is the running integral of Y.

relations.name: is_convolved_with
relations.definition: X is convolved with Y.

relations.name: convolution_produces
relations.definition: Convolving X produces Y.

relations.name: is_multiplied_by
relations.definition: X is multiplied by Y (time or frequency domain).

relations.name: is_sum_of
relations.definition: X is the sum of Y.

relations.name: is_product_of
relations.definition: X is the product of Y.

relations.name: is_reciprocal_of
relations.definition: X is the reciprocal of Y.

relations.name: is_shifted_in_time_by
relations.definition: X is delayed or advanced by Y.

relations.name: is_scaled_by
relations.definition: X is scaled in time or amplitude by Y.

relations.name: is_reflected_by
relations.definition: X is time-reversed by Y.

relations.name: is_conjugate_of
relations.definition: X is the complex conjugate of Y.

relations.name: equals
relations.definition: X is numerically equal to Y.

relations.name: has_input
relations.definition: Y is an input of system X.

relations.name: produces_output
relations.definition: System X produces output Y.

relations.name: is_response_to
relations.definition: X is the response of a system to input Y.

relations.name: has_impulse_response
relations.definition: Y is the impulse response of system X.

relations.name: has_step_response
relations.definition: Y is the step response of system X.

relations.name: has_frequency_response
relations.definition: Y is the frequency response of system X.

relations.name: has_transfer_function
relations.definition: Y is the system function H(s) or H(z) of system X.

relations.name: governed_by_equation
relations.definition: X obeys the differential or difference equation Y.

relations.name: has_eigenfunction
relations.definition: Y is an eigenfunction of system or operation X.

relations.name: has_eigenvalue
relations.definition: Y is the eigenvalue of X for its eigenfunction.

relations.name: is_cascade_of
relations.definition: System X is a series connection of Y.

relations.name: is_parallel_combination_of
relations.definition: System X is a parallel connection of Y.

relations.name: has_order
relations.definition: System or filter X has order Y.

relations.name: has_time_constant
relations.definition: System X has time constant Y.

relations.name: has_damping_ratio
relations.definition: System X has damping ratio Y.

relations.name: has_natural_frequency
relations.definition: System X has natural frequency Y.

relations.name: has_gain
relations.definition: X has gain Y.

relations.name: has_group_delay
relations.definition: X has group delay Y.

relations.name: has_memory_of
relations.definition: System X depends on past values Y.

relations.name: has_magnitude_spectrum
relations.definition: Y is the magnitude spectrum of X.

relations.name: has_phase_spectrum
relations.definition: Y is the phase spectrum of X.

relations.name: has_fundamental_frequency
relations.definition: Y is the fundamental frequency of periodic signal X.

relations.name: has_harmonic
relations.definition: Y is a harmonic of X.

relations.name: satisfies_parseval_relation
relations.definition: X obeys Parseval's relation (energy equal in both domains).

relations.name: converges_to
relations.definition: X (series, sequence, integral) converges to Y.

relations.name: has_bandwidth
relations.definition: X has bandwidth Y.

relations.name: has_window_function
relations.definition: Y is the window function applied to X.

relations.name: exhibits_gibbs_phenomenon
relations.definition: Partial sums of X overshoot near discontinuities.

relations.name: is_filtered_by
relations.definition: Signal X is passed through filter Y.

relations.name: has_passband
relations.definition: Filter X passes the band Y.

relations.name: has_stopband
relations.definition: Filter X rejects the band Y.

relations.name: has_cutoff_frequency
relations.definition: Filter X has cutoff frequency Y.

relations.name: attenuates
relations.definition: X reduces the amplitude of Y.

relations.name: passes
relations.definition: Filter X lets Y through.

relations.name: has_region_of_convergence
relations.definition: The transform X converges for the set of values Y (ROC).

relations.name: has_pole
relations.definition: Y is a pole of X.

relations.name: has_zero
relations.definition: Y is a zero of X.

relations.name: evaluated_via_pole_zero_plot
relations.definition: X is evaluated or sketched from its pole-zero plot Y.

relations.name: determines_location_of
relations.definition: X fixes where Y lies (e.g. poles in the s-plane).

relations.name: is_sampled_by
relations.definition: Signal X is sampled by process Y.

relations.name: produces_samples
relations.definition: Sampling X yields the samples Y.

relations.name: requires_sampling_rate
relations.definition: Sampling X requires at least rate Y.

relations.name: can_cause_aliasing
relations.definition: Operation X can produce aliasing Y.

relations.name: is_reconstructed_by
relations.definition: The sampled signal X is recovered by process Y.

relations.name: is_interpolated_by
relations.definition: X is interpolated by method Y.

relations.name: is_decimated_by
relations.definition: X is decimated (downsampled) by Y.

relations.name: is_upsampled_by
relations.definition: X is upsampled by Y.

relations.name: is_modulated_by
relations.definition: Carrier or signal X is modulated by Y.

relations.name: is_demodulated_by
relations.definition: The modulated signal X is recovered by demodulation method Y.

relations.name: has_carrier
relations.definition: Modulated signal X uses carrier Y.

relations.name: is_multiplexed_with
relations.definition: X shares a channel with Y by multiplexing.

relations.name: has_sideband
relations.definition: Modulated signal X has sideband Y.

relations.name: has_modulation_index
relations.definition: Modulated signal X has modulation index Y.

relations.name: affects_stability_of
relations.definition: X determines or influences the stability of Y (includes tests for stability).

relations.name: is_stabilized_by
relations.definition: System X is made stable by Y.

relations.name: has_feedback_path
relations.definition: System X has feedback path Y.

relations.name: has_open_loop_transfer_function
relations.definition: Y is the open-loop system function of X.

relations.name: has_closed_loop_transfer_function
relations.definition: Y is the closed-loop system function of X.

relations.name: has_gain_margin
relations.definition: Y is the gain margin of X.

relations.name: has_phase_margin
relations.definition: Y is the phase margin of X.

relations.name: is_used_for
relations.definition: X is used to achieve Y.

relations.name: is_used_in_analysis_of
relations.definition: X is a tool for analysing Y.

relations.name: is_applied_to
relations.definition: X is applied to Y.

relations.name: is_computed_by
relations.definition: X is calculated using method Y.

relations.name: has_solution
relations.definition: Y is the solution of equation or problem X.

relations.name: is_derived_from
relations.definition: X is obtained from Y.

relations.name: is_illustrated_by
relations.definition: X is shown by example or figure Y.

relations.name: causes
relations.definition: X produces the effect Y.

relations.name: results_in
relations.definition: X leads to the outcome Y.
